title: Trust Tree
tagline: A discord Bot that allows  DAOs to create positive reinforcement, curate, validate and monitor trust within their community.
description:
A tool for DAOs to create positive reinforcement, curate, validate and monitor trust within their community. This is modular system can be the seed to build trust and collaboration across communities and eventually across the world. 
Leverage pre-existing pockets of trust within the community to build meaningful endorsements across the community
Start pretty centralized in these pockets, but gradually, meaningfully decentralizes the trust by providing threshold levels of endorsement to become an endorser
The community can dispute any endorsement made by these “trusted” endorsers - this opens a dispute resolution oracle
Build a “stanford” in the DAO that functions as a credibility bank within the community that lets othesrs build up credibility in a way that is meaningful to that community
how_its_made: A discord bot written with discord JS that call server less functions to different protocols. We had a smart contract that mints the genesis cohort NFT upon confirmation of n worldcoin verifications. We deployed our own TRUST token & bridged it to Optimism to be used as the governance token. Whenever an endorsement is made through the discord bot, an automatic assertion is made to UMA that is then given a day to be disputed.
